attributes.name: Spirit Blade
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d4+2; you may additionally recharge this card to add another 2d4 and the Force trait. If a monster has an effect that increases the difficulty of this check, ignore that effect.

On your combat check, if you played another weapon or a spell, discard this card to add 1d4+1 and the Force trait.
